officialEvidence.finding: Police Constable GD 2026 row links online form, original rulebook and revised first page.
One Police Constable GD application row gives 22 September to 6 October 2026 and official form target.
Hindi rulebook section 3(i) requires Indian citizenship. Written test is Hindi multiple choice. 11 October is correction deadline, not a new application deadline.
Scanned revised first page, visually reviewed. Application dates unchanged; category fees and Madhya Pradesh domicile fee concession require founder transcription review.

internationalApplicantAssessment: Indian citizenship is expressly required for application; a foreign citizen without Indian citizenship does not match. An Indian citizen still needs age, qualifications, physical and document checks.
languageAssessment: Hindi is the written examination medium; no formal Hindi proficiency level or certificate was found in the checked notice sections.
datePrecision: New applications close 2026-10-06. Official cutoff clock time and timezone were not printed in the checked notices; do not invent either.
venueAssessment: No venue pin assigned from Madhya Pradesh hiring jurisdiction. Exam and physical-test venue remain unknown in the draft.
access: Both official HTML pages and both PDFs responded. MPESB and MPOnline robots.txt returned HTTP 404. Existing MPPSC source remains blocked by robots policy.
coverageLimit: One MPESB intake only. Other MPESB notices, MPPSC recruitment and all other Madhya Pradesh authorities remain independent coverage work.
